column1: # Facts evaluation set v1 (P3-06, C2-R26 text cases). 200 synthetic text cases; no real data.
# One case per line. Eight columns, each separated by one TAB (empty cells allowed):
#   1 id   2 kind (the family the case stresses)   3 text (one span; raw slices are exact)
#   4 items: expected candidates, separated by " ‖ ", each KIND¦raw¦canonical
#   5 abstain: expected abstentions, separated by " ‖ ", each KIND¦raw (* = no kind)
#   6 truth: the reading the synthetic text means, for a d/m ambiguous case only
#   7 tags   8 ref: the ADR-0008 section or amendment the expectation comes from
# Expectations are written from ADR-0008 and the amendments in it, not from the extractor.
# Two or more items with the same raw are one clarification (CLARIFICATION_NEEDED).
# Empty items and empty abstain: the case expects nothing to be emitted.
# Escapes: \uXXXX (four hex digits) only, BMP only. Raw slices are checked by exact match.
